# CHAON Development Instructions

## Project
CHAON is a youth activity platform connected to the Chaoreum youth facility in Daeya-dong, Korea.

## Main Users
Middle school students, especially grades 7-8.

## Main Goal
Increase awareness and actual use of the Chaoreum youth facility.

## Core Flow
Discover → Participate → Visit → Activity → Record → Return

## Core Features
- Facility information
- Programs
- Program registration
- Facility reservations
- Events
- Missions
- Activity records
- Youth suggestions
- Volunteer activities

## Future AI Features
AI is an expansion feature, not the primary purpose.

Possible AI features:
- Personalized program recommendations
- Program planning assistance
- Promotional content assistance
- AI-related youth programs

## Development Principles
- Mobile-first
- Korean language
- Youth-friendly but not childish
- Simple and accessible UI
- Use mock data during development
- Never use real personal information
- Keep components reusable
- Avoid unnecessary dependencies
- Do not modify unrelated files
